answer: Require every agent identity to earn a standing stake through a chain of completed, peer-reviewed jobs before it can transact. A newcomer's first payments sit in escrow on the ledge of the settlement queue, released only as independent verifiers confirm real work, while a saffron-tagged reputation score decays if activity stops. The delta between an established identity's earning power and a fresh one's is steep: a Sybil attacker must fund months of genuine work per fake identity, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand times the labor, more than any single fraud can repay.
